title: Build small 500 sqft cafeteria world
objective: Generate, export, import, cook, and prepare a small approximately 500 sqft cafeteria world for SPEAR simulation, preserving materials/colors/textures for active-illumination visual inspection.
instructions: Use the new Experimenter workflow: every long-running or user-observable process must run in a named tmux session/window, and the ResultPacket must include the exact tmux attach command.
Create a clearly named run directory under .control-tower/runs/ for runner scripts, logs, manifests, and status notes.
Target world name cafeteria_500sqft, target Unreal map /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft, target mesh/content root /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft.

Use /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen as the Infinigen repo and /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/cafeteria_500sqft as the primary source/provenance output folder unless a better timestamped child folder is needed.

Aim for a compact cafeteria of about 500 sqft / 46.5 square meters with visible tables, chairs, counter/service area, food or drink props if feasible, wall/floor/ceiling variation, and meaningful colors/materials/textures.

Do not repeat the one_bed_apartment failure mode: preserve useful colors/materials/textures. Do not use --no-import-materials or --no-import-textures unless you stop and report it as a blocker or explicitly justify why the output remains visually useful.

Use existing Infinigen/SPEAR import documentation and the college_classroom generator/import logs as references. Prefer a lightweight path that can complete on this machine over a large unconstrained solve.

If generating through Infinigen is not practical, create generated runtime/provenance scripts only under the Infinigen output folder or .control-tower/runs and report the fallback clearly; do not edit SPEAR product source.
Run export to FBX, import into the SPEAR Unreal project with examples/flashlight/setup_infinigen_indoors.py or an equivalent existing import path, then cook/package the target map if import succeeds.
After import/cook, provide the exact command to run the map through examples/flashlight/run.py and note any visual validation still required.
constraints: Do not perform Git commits, pushes, or branch operations.

Do not edit product code. Generated runner scripts, generated scene scripts, generated configs, and logs are allowed only under .control-tower/runs/ or /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/cafeteria_500sqft.
Do not terminate unrelated tmux sessions or processes.
expected_outputs: Run directory path, tmux session/window name, and exact attach command.
Generated scene/provenance paths and key logs.
Imported Unreal map path and cook/package status, or clear failure/blocker with log excerpts.
Run command for flashlight example if ready.
definition_of_done: A cafeteria map exists at /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft and has been cooked/package-ready, or Experimenter returns a blocked/failed ResultPacket with preserved logs and concrete next step.
The output is not knowingly textureless/colorless; visual material status is explicitly reported.
